directionContract.thesis: Daily memory capture for real friendships—not a generic social feed or planning dashboard.
directionContract.world: Oat cream, baked apricot, deep moss, terracotta warmth, quiet flax edges, and the small Memory Seedling.
directionContract.story: Open fresh stories from your circle, keep one small memory, choose its people and privacy, then watch the Memory Seedling keep it safe.
directionContract.firstViewport: Stories lead a warm cream home feed; a native five-tab bar keeps Add Memory in the center.
directionContract.form: Apricot Moss with native iOS Liquid Glass navigation and soft, organic memory surfaces.
